Theorem trace_four_N_powers_explicit_of_OAnti applies after cyclic rotation. For p <= 10 and four K*N factors, each cyclic gap exponent is gap+1 <= (p-4)+1 <= 7 < 2^m for m >= 3; supply two such gaps as b,d. This yields the explicit nested boundary sum, not a proved cancellation of the stratum.

Theorem trace_five_N_powers_zero_of_OAnti applies after cyclic rotation and splitting one cyclic K-gap into the two exterior powers. For p <= 10, every positive gap exponent is at most p-4 <= 6 < 2^m for m >= 3, so the two explicit middle-power corner hypotheses hold under OAnti (m+1) o.

Theorem trace_six_N_powers_boundary applies after cyclic rotation and pairing the six N factors into three N*K^b*N blocks. For p <= 10, every cyclic gap exponent (gap + 1) is at most p - r + 1 <= 5 < 2^m for m >= 3, so the three corner hypotheses follow from sgK_pow_GlueDiag_of_OAnti under OAnti (m+1) o. The theorem gives an explicit trace of three diagonal boundary factors separated by powers of K; it does not prove cancellation or vanishing of this stratum. Strata r >= 7 remain outside the current generic reductions. Do not infer the p-moment identity from the boundary formula alone.
